description:
We are looking to recruit a Sightseeing Driver / Tour Host for tourist tours and transfers operated from Bucharest.

The ideal candidate is a responsible, service-oriented, and well-organized person, with good driving skills, a professional attitude, and the ability to interact confidently with international tourists.


Key requirements:

• Valid Category B driving licence required; Category D would be considered an advantage.

• Good driving skills and responsible driving behaviour.

• Good command of English.

• Knowledge of Italian or Spanish would be considered an advantage.

• Professional attitude and good communication skills.

• Punctual, reliable, and well organised.

• Availability for a flexible work schedule, including weekends and public holidays, depending on operational needs.

• Ability to work well with tourists and manage small groups in a calm and professional manner.


Main responsibilities:

• Ensure safe and comfortable transportation for tourists according to the established schedule.

• Welcome and assist guests during tours and transfers.

• Provide logistical support and clear communication throughout the activity.

• Offer basic assistance and help maintain a smooth and well-organised guest experience.

• Follow internal procedures and company standards at all times.


Previous experience in one or more of the following areas would be considered an advantage:

• tourism;

• passenger transport;

• customer service;

• tour assistance or group coordination.


Additional advantages:

• Good knowledge of Bucharest and major tourist destinations in Romania.

• Ability to communicate in additional foreign languages.

• Positive attitude and attention to detail in guest interaction.
